text: 【下调利率25个基点！央行优化股票回购增持再贷款政策】另据参会人士透露，会上强调，银行应按市场化原则，合理确定股票回购增持贷款利率水平，避免过度“内卷”竞争，保持商业可持续。下一步银行要积极满足不同上市公司需求，对估值偏离大的企业加强研判；对行业龙头加强重点对接，发挥带头作用；对上市公司集聚地区加强资源倾斜。
text_en: [Rate cut of 25 basis points! PBOC optimizes stock repurchase and increase-holding relending policy] Separately, according to attendees, the meeting emphasized that banks should reasonably determine the interest rate level for stock repurchase and increase-holding loans in accordance with market-based principles, avoid excessive "involution-style" competition, and maintain commercial sustainability. Next, banks should actively meet the needs of different listed companies, strengthen analysis of companies with large valuation deviations, strengthen focused engagement with industry leaders so they can play a leading role, and increase resource allocation toward regions with concentrated listed companies.
